verdict.rationale: Glama's llms.txt says every listed server is "scanned, scored," which is a first-party claim of platform-side inspection of the directory. The text is truncated and never says the scanning targets malicious or vulnerable behavior. The community-discussed quality score and the manual browser Inspector are about description quality and interactive testing, not security vetting. Missing for 10: documentation of what the scan checks (malware or vulnerability detection), how results are surfaced or gate agent use, and independent corroboration of security scanning.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on the platform scanning or inspecting listed servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior before my agents use them

citations.quote: A directory of 91,626 Model Context Protocol servers and 23,749 remote connectors, every one scanned, scored,
